facts.fact: A parliamentary committee report of 23 June 2026 records Stats SA briefing it on 28 April 2026 on its proposed amendment of the Statistics Act (No. 6 of 1999), so the 1999 Act is the law in force, and lists rolling out amendments under Act No. 29 of 2024 as a 2026 priority.

note: Regulations and about 20 MoUs are said to be under development for the amendments: no dated rule made and no dated act under the law, so no reach fact.
